content: For visible pre-grasp real/sim disagreement, separate scene placement, camera mounting and physical tool geometry using matched noncontact views. Check scene-fit candidates against robot-attached geometry excluded from fitting. Measure target-array equality and wall-clock timing separately.
applicability: RGB-only robot with reliable recorded joint feedback and simulation-safe stand-off viewpoints; exact camera/robot embodiment must match
count_scope: Candidate calibrations accepted/rejected, not robot tasks
limitations: One acquisition; no causal proof of improved collection cost
Known-size target or verified attached landmarks still needed for metric qualification
